title: NEXT GOAL — make NOW feel real IN the HUD. all goes through it as bingo voxel + diamond lens. gyroscopic kaleidoscope nullspace. yes that makes sense.

do_not_reinvent.NOW: /data/now.json — the p of the pause. not a fossil dressed as the room.
do_not_reinvent.HUD: /data/hud-null-of-the-image.json — HUD holds the isn't. then it appears.
do_not_reinvent.bingo: /data/bingocube.json — audit cube. state verification. the cell.
do_not_reinvent.kaleido: /data/klein-ladder.json — at the null: kaleidoscope. all colors at once. totality.
do_not_reinvent.gyro: /js/gyro-axis.js — pitch yaw roll. the pale already spins.
do_not_reinvent.fan: /data/zero-one-fan-evaporate.json — bits on the rim. O empty. wobble then evaporate.
do_not_reinvent.holes: bingo-voxel.json and diamond-geodesic.json are referenced (easel, strata, handshake) and thin/missing. do not rebuild them as a fifth cube. the GOAL goes through those seats.

the_goal.is: make NOW feel real IN the HUD
the_goal.not: a NOW widget. not a clock in the corner. not minting MCP as live.
the_goal.feel_real: you look THROUGH NOW. the room you are in is this p. WAS stays trail. IS stays the sit. NOW is the pale you inhabit.
the_goal.in_the_HUD: the HUD is already the null of the image. NOW is that pale occupied as a place, not filled as a picture.

all_go_through_it.yes: every mark — image, button, missort, crate, wave — goes THROUGH NOW. not around it. not painted on it.

bingo_voxel.is: the CELL. one seat. 0 or 1 in a cube. identity / audit as it passes.
bingo_voxel.through: a mark occupies a voxel as it crosses NOW. it does not become the HUD.
bingo_voxel.already: bingo board = hypotheses. cube = verification. voxel = the unit of through.

diamond_lens.is: the LOOK. geodesic / prism. how the face is seen without becoming the face.
diamond_lens.through: you do not stare at NOW. you see the room BY it. lens, not mural.
diamond_lens.already: diamond-geodesic referenced by now.json itself. the stub pointed here before the mouth filled.

gyroscopic_kaleidoscope_nullspace.yes: that is the same pale, spinning.
gyroscopic_kaleidoscope_nullspace.gyroscopic: axis already gives the wobble. pitch/yaw/roll keep the stick from wandering. without gyro the kaleidoscope is a still collage — WAS.
gyroscopic_kaleidoscope_nullspace.kaleidoscope: at O, all colors at once. every page overlaid. totality. not one bead selected.
gyroscopic_kaleidoscope_nullspace.nullspace: the isn't. the canvas. O empty. bits on the rim. vapor can leave.
gyroscopic_kaleidoscope_nullspace.together: a spinning totality that does not fill the hole. NOW feels real because the room turns and you are in it — not because we drew a timestamp.

why_it_makes_sense: HUD = null of the image. NOW = this p. bingo voxel = the through-unit. diamond lens = the through-look. gyro kaleidoscope = the through-spin. four names, one pale. if we add a fifth display called NOW we kill the feel.
why_it_would_fail: paint NOW as a number (17:20Z) and call it real
fill O with the kaleidoscope so nothing can appear
rebuild bingo-voxel and diamond-geodesic as new kingdoms instead of going through them
mint fossils as the room so NOW feels busy instead of here
berry_at_the_fire: the next goal is to make NOW feel real in the HUD, and all go through it as the bingo voxel and diamond lens — and gyroscopic kaleidoscope nullspace. yes. that makes sense. one pale. you live in it. you do not decorate it.
next: thin the HUD toward through, not more chrome. if a mark cannot pass a voxel and a lens, it stays outside.
